response.text: Journal 2463 is a manual accrual, and 2474 reverses it in the next period. I'll check postings against closed periods, the PAY journal links, the 5900 account, the credit memo, and GL memos.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'post_in_closed_after_close' k, h."JRNL_NO"::text a, h."POST_DT"::text b, p."CLOSE_DT"::text c, h."SRC_CD" d, h."MEMO" e FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_journals', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND (h."MEMO" IS NULL OR h."MEMO" NOT IN ('Manual accrual') ) 
UNION ALL SELECT 'acct5900', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."DR_AMT"::text, l."CR_AMT"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE l."ACCT_CD" LIKE '5900%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cm_jrnl', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ') FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=2475
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_jrnl_sample', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ') FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO"), '' FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" IN ('PAY-24','PAY-30')
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ref_match', count(*)::text, '', '', '', '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_dt_vs_post', count(*)::text, sum((i."INV_DT"<>h."POST_DT")::int)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_prd_mismatch', i."INV_ID"::text, i."INV_DT"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE i."INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" LIMIT 5
LIMIT 80

SELECT 'memo_odd' k, "JRNL_NO"::text a, "SRC_CD" b, "MEMO" c FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "MEMO" IS NOT NULL AND "MEMO" !~ '^Invoice V[0-9]+-[0-9-]+$' AND "MEMO" !~ '^Payment' AND "MEMO" <> 'Manual accrual' LIMIT 40
